pages.brief: Nell the bee and Pip the sparrow side by side at the edge of a stream, both poised and ready to race.
Pip the sparrow flying just ahead of Nell the bee, both racing low over a rushing stream.
Nell the bee pausing mid-race over the stream, noticing a small brown beetle struggling on a floating leaf.
Nell the bee carefully nudging a small brown beetle from a floating leaf onto a safe leaf by the bank.
Nell the bee landing on the far bank of the stream last, looking a little glum, while Pip the sparrow waits.
Pip the sparrow smiling and giving Nell the bee a gentle wing-nudge, a rescued beetle safe on the bank nearby.
